set.t: Look for the old grove on the 1930s aerial. Private land: ask permission. The real 1868 Newton robbery: about $3,600-4,000 in greenbacks blown from the Jasper Co treasurer's safe on 25 Feb 1868; Pinkerton's H. W. Davis tracked four men who left by train west next morning, got off at Mitchellville and went on to Chicago, where Chas. Udell and Abram Richardson (the 'Abraham Ross' of March reports) were arrested; they got 10 and 7 years in Dec 1868. 'Of the $3,600 of which the county was robbed only $945 were recovered' (the 1878 county history gives $954); the others were never caught. About $2,650 was never recovered, but it was paper money, the flight ran east by rail, and no period record puts any of it near State Center.

set.tovw: Lead grade F: recovered Sept 1920 (local original read); the family's 4 Sep 1920 denial letter reads as protection against a treasure-trove claim
